task_grounding: FreeCAD is open with /home/user/Documents/fem_start.FCStd. The document contains a Part::Box named 'Beam' (200 x 20 x 10 mm). Switch to the FEM workbench. Create a new Analysis container named exactly 'Analysis'. Inside the Analysis: (1) add a Fixed Constraint on the face of Beam at X = 0 (the -X face), (2) add a Force Constraint on the face at X = 200 (the +X face) with Force = 100 N pointing in the -Z direction, (3) add a Solid Material using the CalculiX default steel preset, and (4) generate a Gmsh FEM mesh of Beam. Save the file with Ctrl+S.
